intent.outcome: A `mp milestone verify <id>` command re-runs each acceptance criterion's runnable verification command and reports pass/fail; `mp milestone complete` refuses to flip a milestone to `done` while any runnable AC verification fails, closing the gap that allowed milestones to be stamped complete with fabricated or contradictory AC evidence.

problem.description: mp allows a milestone to be marked execution_status: done + spec_status: verified with acceptance-criteria evidence/verification fields that are never checked. In commit 61ff074, M18-M22 were stamped done with AC evidence that was plainly false: M22 AC-02 ('grep tera crates/mp/Cargo.toml returns zero') was marked `passed` while `tera = "1"` remained at crates/mp/Cargo.toml:26; M20 AC-01 ('ARCHITECTURE.md created') passed though the file has no git add-commit; M21 AC-01 ('crate count <= 150') passed while cargo tree returned 264. `mp validate` stayed green throughout. There is no mechanism to detect or prevent false completion, so the plan's core 'done means done' contract is unenforced and every completed milestone's trustworthiness depends entirely on operator discipline.

in_scope: Add `mp milestone verify <id>`: classify each AC `verification` string as runnable (cargo/make/./scripts/grep/test-style commands) vs manual (prose or `manual:` prefix) vs empty; execute the runnable ones; print per-AC pass/fail with actual output.

Only a curated command-prefix allow-list is executed (cargo, make, ./, grep, rg, test, ls); unknown commands are classified as manual, not executed. Runs via bounded subprocess with no shell interpolation.

Gate `mp milestone complete <id>`: run verification first; refuse `done` (exit non-zero, naming the failing ACs) if any runnable AC fails. `--force` bypasses the gate and records that verification was bypassed.
Report manual and empty verifications separately (non-blocking); warn on empty verifications.
Unit tests for verification-string classification; integration test with a fixture milestone mixing passing / failing / manual / empty ACs.
out_of_scope: Retroactive auto-audit sweep of already-done milestones (the command is available; no scheduled sweep).
Detecting fabricated prose evidence beyond running the verification command (only runnable commands can be checked).
Changing the AC TOML schema (reuse the existing `verification` field; classification is derived at runtime).

acceptance_criteria.description: mp milestone verify classifies each AC verification as runnable/manual/empty and executes the runnable ones.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: ac_verify.rs: classify() (12-case unit test) + run_one() + verify_milestone(); runnable ACs executed via allow-listed sh -c.

acceptance_criteria.description: verify reports per-AC pass/fail with command output and exits non-zero when any runnable AC fails.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: verify_reports_and_exits_nonzero_on_failure: verify on a failing-runnable fixture exits non-zero and names the AC.

acceptance_criteria.description: mp milestone complete runs verification and refuses done when any runnable AC fails; completes when all runnable ACs pass.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: complete_refused_on_failing_runnable_ac: complete refused (exit 2, gate=ac-verification); milestone stays in-progress.

acceptance_criteria.description: --force on complete bypasses the verify gate and records that verification was bypassed.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: complete_force_bypasses_gate: complete --force succeeds; evidence stamped 'verification force-bypassed'.

acceptance_criteria.description: manual (manual:) and empty verifications are reported separately and do not block completion; empty is flagged.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: manual_and_empty_do_not_block: manual+empty-only milestone completes (exit 0); empty flagged in verify report.

acceptance_criteria.description: Existing tests pass; no behavior change for milestones whose verifications are all manual/empty.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo test -p mp green (51 suites); make test-scenarios + make adopt-check green.

design_decisions.choice: Step-test verification at gate time: classify + run step tests at milestone verify/complete, not at step done
design_decisions.rationale: Keeps the step-done path fast while catching failures at the decision point

work_packages.name: Verify core
work_packages.goal: Classify + execute AC verifications and expose mp milestone verify

work_packages.name: Complete gate
work_packages.goal: mp milestone complete refuses done on failing AC; --force bypass recorded

steps.action: Add crates/mp/src/ac_verify.rs: classify(verification_str) -> Kind {Runnable, Manual, Empty} via curated allow-list prefix (cargo, make, ./, grep, rg, test, ls); manual: prefix and prose -> Manual; blank -> Empty. Add execute(cmd) running a bounded subprocess (no shell interpolation) capturing stdout/stderr + exit code. Register module in lib.rs.
steps.done_when: classify() returns the right Kind for cargo/make/./grep/manual:/empty; execute runs an allow-listed command and returns output + status

steps.action: Gate mp milestone complete: before flipping to done, run ac_verify on the milestone; if any runnable AC fails, refuse with a clear error naming the failing ACs (exit non-zero). Succeeds when all runnable ACs pass.
steps.done_when: complete refused on a milestone with a failing runnable AC (names it); completes when all runnable ACs pass

steps.action: Add --force to mp milestone complete: bypasses the verify gate and records in the milestone evidence/verification that completion was force-bypassed.
steps.done_when: complete --force succeeds on a failing-AC milestone and stamps bypass evidence

steps.action: Integration coverage: a fixture/test milestone mixing passing / failing / manual / empty ACs; assert manual + empty do not block completion and empty is flagged as a warning.
steps.done_when: milestone with only manual + empty ACs completes successfully; empty verifications produce a warning

steps.action: Final M30 gate: cargo test -p mp green (no regressions; milestones with only manual/empty verifications unchanged), make adopt-check green, mp validate green; record evidence.
steps.done_when: AC-06 verified; cargo test -p mp green; make adopt-check green; mp validate green

steps.action: Wire the mp milestone verify subcommand: cli.rs enum variant + app.rs dispatch + commands/milestone.rs handler. Load the milestone, classify and execute each AC, build a per-AC report (ac_id, kind, passed, output); exit non-zero if any runnable AC fails. JSON format emits the report.
steps.done_when: verify --format json returns per-AC results for a milestone; exits non-zero when a runnable AC fails and names it

steps.action: Add human-format output for verify: a readable per-AC table (runnable pass/fail with output, manual labeled, empty flagged), via render.rs or the command handler.
steps.done_when: human format renders the per-AC table; runnable rows show pass/fail, manual rows labeled, empty rows flagged

verification.evidence: All 6 ACs verified; gate self-tested on M30 (verify 30 green). v1.3.1.
